QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] An Additional Request
QuestInfo.0: You kept your promise to Muhammad. Talk to him to receive the Lidium.
QuestInfo.1: Why would Muhammad go back on his word? He may have only asked you to defeat the Desert Rabbits before, but obtaining the Lidium has gotten a bit more complicated. Perhaps the diplomatic thing to do would be to help him out for now.
QuestInfo.2: You fulfilled Muhammad's request and obtained the Lidium. At least you were able to help someone out...
